title: Enforce Dedicated Management Plane Isolation and Control Plane Policing
description: Administrative management traffic must be strictly isolated within a dedicated management VRF or out-of-band network. Control Plane Policing (CoPP) must rate limit control plane traffic.
rationale: Combining management and data plane traffic exposes management interfaces to denial-of-service and unauthorized internal access.
failure_message: Management interface is not isolated inside a dedicated management VRF or CoPP is not configured.

title: Configure Inbound and Outbound Access Control Lists with Explicit Default Deny
description: Traffic interfaces must enforce stateful or stateless Access Control Lists (ACLs) containing an explicit deny-all rule at the end with logging enabled.
rationale: Without explicit deny ACLs and interface binding, unauthenticated traffic may traverse unauthorized boundaries.
failure_message: Interfaces lack inbound/outbound ACL filtering with an explicit default deny rule.

title: Enforce Stateful Firewall Policies and Anti-Spoofing Rules
description: Firewalls and security gateways must enforce stateful inspection, strict zone-based security policies, reverse-path forwarding (uRPF) anti-spoofing, and drop unassigned broadcast traffic.
rationale: Misconfigured firewall policies or missing anti-spoofing controls allow IP spoofing, lateral movement, and unauthorized network ingress.
failure_message: Stateful firewall inspection, zone policies, or anti-spoofing filtering are not fully enforced.

title: Mandate Strong Cryptography and MFA for Remote Access VPNs
description: Remote access VPN concentrators must mandate multi-factor authentication (MFA), IKEv2 / TLS 1.3 key exchange, and AES-GCM encryption suites.
rationale: Legacy IKEv1 and single-factor VPN access represent primary entry vectors for network intrusions and ransomware operators.
failure_message: Remote access VPN does not enforce MFA or utilizes deprecated IKEv1 / weak DH groups.

title: Enforce Login Failure Rate Limiting and Account Lockout Thresholds
description: Authentication services must enforce consecutive failed login lockout thresholds (maximum 5 attempts within 1 minute) to mitigate automated brute-force attacks.
rationale: Unthrottled login attempts permit online dictionary attacks and credential stuffing against device administrative endpoints.
failure_message: Login block / rate-limiting for failed authentication attempts is not configured.

title: Enforce Granular Command Authorization and Role-Based Privilege Separation
description: Commands executed on the device must be authorized against centralized RBAC authorization policies. Read-only operators must not have executive configuration privileges.
rationale: Lack of command authorization allows operators with low privilege to execute unauthorized configuration modifications.
failure_message: Command authorization (AAA authorization exec/commands) is not configured.

title: Enforce Cryptographic Neighbor Authentication on Routing Protocols
description: Dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, IS-IS) must mandate MD5/SHA-256 HMAC neighbor authentication and BGP TTL security / GTSM.
rationale: Unauthenticated routing adjacencies allow malicious route injection, traffic blackholing, and unauthorized traffic redirection.
failure_message: Routing peers (BGP/OSPF) are configured without cryptographic neighbor authentication.

title: Enforce Layer 2 Interface Security: Port Security, BPDU Guard, and Storm Control
description: Access switchports must have Port Security enabled, Spanning Tree PortFast BPDU Guard active, storm-control broadcast suppression, and unused interfaces shut down.
rationale: Unsecured access ports enable MAC flooding, rogue switch STP root election takeover, and broadcast storm denial of service.
failure_message: Access switchports lack Port Security, BPDU Guard, or storm control protection.
